title: 第1545章 暴打统帅小舅子第1544章 伤兵们的悲惨遭遇
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
秦峰立刻大踏步向那个小院去，还没靠近就听里面管弦之声不绝于耳。
琵琶铮铮，笛声婉转，还夹着女子娇笑和酒杯碰撞的叮当声。
秦峰一脚就将大门踹的粉碎，然后冲进院子。
红木门板裂成七八块飞出去，惊得两个侍女尖叫着跌坐在地。
一个青年男子正在饮酒作乐，此人便是孙荣。
他歪在躺椅上，怀里搂着两个浓妆女子，桌上是山珍海味、玉液琼浆。
他见有人竟然敢闯他的院子，顿时大怒，在这镇邪关还从来没有人敢这样对他。
孙荣猛地推开怀中女子，抓起酒壶砸向秦峰，酒液泼洒一地。
“大胆！你是何人？竟敢擅闯我的院落。”
他面皮涨红，脖子上青筋暴起，但身形虚浮，脚下已有些不稳。
秦峰并没有回答他，而是反问道：“你就是孙荣？”
他伸手精准接住砸来的酒壶，轻轻一握，瓷壶碎成粉末飘落。
孙荣道：“是又如何？”
他挺了挺胸，拽出腰间一枚金色令牌晃了晃，上面刻着统帅府印记。
秦峰道：“没找错人就好。”然后他二话不说上去就是一个巴掌。
巴掌带起凌厉风声，在空中划出一道残影，快得孙荣反应不及。
这一巴掌力道十足，而且是出其不意，孙荣直接被扇飞了出去，牙齿掉了好几颗。
他整个人在空中翻了个圈，撞翻了酒桌，汤汤水水泼了一身。
孙荣怒吼：“我不管你是谁，你死定了！”
他挣扎着爬起来，嘴角淌血，手指哆嗦着去摸腰间传讯符。

然而话音未落，秦峰又一个巴掌扇了过去。再次将孙荣扇飞。
这一掌更狠，孙荣的脸颊瞬间肿起老高，三颗后槽牙混着血飞出老远。
“你个垃圾，连将士们的买命钱你都贪，猪狗不如。”
秦峰声音沉如闷雷，院子里几个舞女吓得蜷在墙角不敢动弹。
随即又一脚踢在对方的腰部，将肋骨都踢断了好几根。
咔嚓声响彻小院，孙荣弓着身子惨叫，像只被踩烂的虾米。
孙荣嘴盯着秦峰，中含糊不清，显然是在骂秦峰。
他满嘴血沫，含混吐出几句威胁，眼神却从凶狠变成了恐惧。
秦峰也不在意，不过目前还不能跟统帅彻底闹僵，所以暂时留他一命。
秦峰收起对方的储物戒，神识一扫。那戒指内光景令他瞳孔一缩，成箱的疗伤丹、神玉、兵器甲胄堆成小山。
里面果然有不少好东西，秦峰将资源跟所有的疗伤丹拿出来，扔给了穆庆凡。
“这些发给将士们！我不希望下次再有这种事情发生。”
秦峰盯着穆庆凡的眼睛，目光里警告意味浓郁得像化不开的墨。
然后便带着苗诗烟离开了，很快便找到了花不羁。
他租了一个不错的院子，院子内有四间房，一棵大柳树，还有一口井。
青砖院墙齐整，院门黑漆崭新，井台上甚至放着一只干净木桶。
秦峰很是满意，找了一间靠大门的侧房住了下来。
房间不大但收拾得清爽，床铺被褥都是新的，桌上还摆着一盏油灯。
content_en:
Qin Feng immediately strode towards the small courtyard. Before he even got close, he could hear the sound of orchestral music inside.
The pipa is clanking, the flute is melodious, and there is also the sound of the woman's smile and the clinking of wine glasses.
Qin Feng kicked the door to pieces and rushed into the yard.
The mahogany door panel split into seven or eight pieces and flew out, causing the two maids to scream and fall to the ground.
A young man was drinking and having fun. This man was Sun Rong.
He was leaning on a reclining chair, holding two women with heavy makeup in his arms. On the table were delicacies from mountains and seas, jade liquid and fine wine.
When he saw someone dared to break into his yard, he was immediately furious. No one in this Zhenxie Pass had ever dared to do this to him.
Sun Rong suddenly pushed the woman in his arms away, grabbed the wine bottle and threw it at Qin Feng, spilling the wine all over the floor.
"Bold! Who are you? How dare you break into my courtyard."
His face turned red and veins popped out on his neck, but his figure was sluggish and his feet were already a little unsteady.
Qin Feng did not answer him, but asked: "Are you Sun Rong?"
He stretched out his hand to catch the flask that was thrown at him, and with a gentle squeeze, the porcelain jug shattered into powder and fell.
Sun Rong said: "So what?"
He straightened his chest, pulled out a golden token from his waist and shook it, with the mark of the Commander-in-Chief's Office engraved on it.
Qin Feng said: "It's good that you didn't find the wrong person." Then he slapped him without saying a word.
The slap caused a sharp sound of wind and drew an afterimage in the air, so fast that Sun Rong could not react in time.
This slap was very powerful and unexpected. Sun Rong was sent flying directly and several teeth fell out.
He turned around in the air, knocked over the wine table, and splashed soup and water all over him.
Sun Rong roared: "I don't care who you are, you are dead!"
He struggled to get up, blood dripping from the corner of his mouth, and his fingers trembled to touch the communication talisman around his waist.
However, before he finished speaking, Qin Feng slapped him again. Sun Rong was slapped away again.
The palm was even harder. Sun Rong's cheek instantly swelled up, and his three back molars flew out far away mixed with blood.
"You piece of trash, you are greedy even for the life money of the soldiers, you are worse than a pig or a dog."
Qin Feng's voice was as deep as thunder, and several dancers in the yard were so frightened that they huddled in the corner and did not dare to move.
Then he kicked the opponent in the waist again, breaking several ribs.
The clicking sound resounded throughout the small courtyard, and Sun Rong hunched over and screamed, like a trampled shrimp.
Sun Rong stared at Qin Feng with his mouth slurred, obviously scolding Qin Feng.
His mouth was full of blood and he uttered a few vague threats, but his eyes changed from fierce to fearful.
Qin Feng didn't care, but he couldn't have a complete stalemate with the commander yet, so he spared his life for the time being.
Qin Feng put away the opponent's storage ring and swept away his consciousness. The sight inside the ring made his pupils shrink. Boxes of healing pills, sacred jade, weapons and armor were piled into a hill.
As expected, there were a lot of good things inside. Qin Feng took out the resources and all the healing pills and threw them to Mu Qingfan.
"Give these to the soldiers! I don't want this to happen again next time."
Qin Feng stared into Mu Qingfan's eyes, the warning in his eyes was as strong as ink that could not be melted away.
Then he took Miao Shiyan away and soon found Hua Buzhi.
He rented a nice yard with four rooms, a big willow tree, and a well.
The green brick courtyard walls are neat, the courtyard door is black and brand new, and there is even a clean wooden barrel on the well platform.
Qin Feng was very satisfied and found a side room near the door to live in.
The room was not big but was neatly tidied, the bed and bedding were all new, and there was an oil lamp on the table.
